candidate: query and aggregate-header byte limits checked on every request
method: Five alternating baseline/candidate runs on Python 3.13.18, same machine, debug-profile extension. Each run uses the existing 7-sample x 20,000-request protected GET microbenchmark after its warm-up.
limits: In-process protected GET with no server, network or database; not an end-to-end throughput result. The candidate's added byte-count scan has an observed ~3.8% median cost in this harness, below the repository's 15% regression detector threshold; this is the cost of enforcing default request bounds.
